emptyChatsText: Your personal Telegram chats will appear here.
selectChatText: Read messages, reply yourself, or let your AI help.

context.heading: Context
context.title: Collect context
context.hint: Update this conversation’s memory now without waiting for the scheduled run.
context.updateHint: Add messages after the last checkpoint while preserving the current summary.
context.rebuildHint: Rebuild the summary from recent messages back to the beginning. The generated summary will be replaced; your notes are preserved.
context.running: This conversation has priority. Collection continues after closing this dialog; AI replies still take precedence.
context.done: Context is updated and available for replies.
context.disabled: Memory is disabled. Enable it in the application and conversation settings.
context.waitingModel: Collection needs an installed default model. Select it on the models page.
context.globalHint: Update the owner profile and selected conversations sequentially. Sources include recent private chats, AI-enabled chats and previously selected sources.
context.globalUpdateHint: Add new messages from all selected sources, keeping existing summaries and the profile.
context.globalRebuildHint: Reprocess available history from selected conversations and rebuild the owner profile. Generated summaries are replaced; your notes are preserved.
context.globalRunning: Selected conversations are processed sequentially with priority. Collection continues after closing this dialog.

contextHint: Your assistant can use the last {count} messages
internetAccessHint: Weather and current information. External services receive only the search query or city.
previewHint: Test a reply without sending it to Telegram.

modelDescription.deepseek: Multi-step reasoning; responses can take longer.
modelDescription.gpt: OpenAI’s open model for reasoning. Requires substantially more memory.
modelDescription.phi: Compact Microsoft model for conversation and reasoning.
modelDescription.qwen-vl: A multimodal model that understands images and replies with text.
modelDescription.custom: An Ollama model installed outside the built-in catalog. Unverified specifications are not displayed.

engineStoppedHint: Installation found. Start Ollama to use your models.
engineHint: Ollama runs local models. Allow around 5 GB for the engine.
speedNote: Smaller models are faster. The first request loads the model into memory; later requests are usually faster.
activityDescription: Reply queue and model request history.
noActivityText: Once you enable the assistant, its activity will appear here.
connectDescription: Sign in to your account. Your session stays on this computer.
step1Text: Open my.telegram.org, sign in with your phone number, then choose API development tools.
step2Text: App title: Aigram · Short name: aigramdesktop · Platform: Desktop. Other fields can be left empty.
step3: 3. Copy API ID and API Hash
step3Text: Paste them below. These are application keys, not a bot token.
codeHint: Usually sent to the official Telegram service chat. Telegram may send an SMS instead.
security: API keys are protected with Windows DPAPI. Login codes and passwords are never saved.
autoNote: Only replies in selected private chats. Groups and bots are excluded.
pauseNote: All automatic replies are currently paused.
enableHint: Enable the assistant for your chosen chats, then start AI.
aiDraftHint: You can edit the draft before sending.
contextNote: AI receives recent messages, including your replies. Long messages and history are limited to fit the context.
testNeedModel: Install a model in AI models first.
logoutConfirm: Disconnect Telegram? Your saved session will be logged out.
quitDone: Application stopped. You can close this tab.
credentialsInvalid: Enter a numeric API ID, a 32-character API Hash and an international phone number.
noHistory: No messages in this conversation yet
privacyText: No cloud AI or subscriptions. Telegram connects directly; AI models run locally.
modelSmallDescription: The lightest model. For short, simple replies.
modelMediumDescription: Quick replies to simple messages. May miss conversational nuances.
modelLargeDescription: For Russian dialogue and complex context. Requires more memory.
welcomeDescription: Replies in your chosen Telegram conversations, follows the context and adapts to the way you write. You decide who it can reply to, how it sounds and when it responds.
welcomeKeys: We will show you where to get your API ID and API Hash.
setupAiHint: Install Ollama and models in a few clicks
globalPromptHint: Instructions for every AI-enabled chat. Individual chat settings add to these instructions. Changes apply to subsequent replies.
unsupportedMedia: This message type is not supported yet
mediaError: Could not load this attachment. Reopen the message to retry.
benchmarkHint: Speed is measured on your computer and saved. Selecting a model starts a test automatically.
queueHint: Replies are processed one at a time. New messages in the same conversation are grouped before replying. A manual reply cancels the automatic reply.
formatRepliesHint: Bold, italics, spoilers and other styles in AI replies.
formattedDraftError: The editor could not preserve formatting. Generate a new draft before sending.
resumeOnStartup: Enable AI when the app starts
resumeOnStartupHint: Start automatic replies for selected conversations whenever the app opens, including Windows startup.
matchMyStyleHint: Uses writing patterns from your own messages: phrase length, casing and punctuation. The selected style sets the tone; past replies are not copied.
welcomeContextDescription: Uses the chat history and the latest messages for context.
welcomeStyleDescription: Takes cues from your wording, tone and messaging habits.
welcomeControlDescription: You choose the contacts, tone of voice and reply delay.
welcomeSignInDescription: Sign in to see your conversations here. Then choose who Aigram can reply to.
welcomeLocal: AI models run on your computer. Internet search can be configured for each conversation.
customStylesHint: Save a tone of voice and reuse it in any conversation.
styleRequired: Enter a name, emoji and instructions.
ignoreAssistantTasksHint: Skip direct tasks such as “give me a pancake recipe”, “write code” or “solve an equation”. Ordinary conversational questions are still allowed.
groupRepliesHint: Applies only to conversations with AI enabled. Each conversation can override this setting.

metrics.title: Resource charts
metrics.description: Computer and application resources · last 3 minutes
metrics.note: Working memory of processes; shared pages may be counted more than once. Network is total computer interface traffic. GPU statistics require NVIDIA drivers.

benchmarkInput: Reply in one short sentence: how are you?
modelResourceHint: Context is the model’s maximum capacity listed by Ollama. The app uses an 8,192-token window to limit memory use. Speed depends on your hardware, conversation length and reasoning.

memory.title: Memory
memory.scheduleHint: The chosen interval applies to each conversation, including new messages and older history. Manual collection runs without waiting for this interval. Replies take priority.
memory.globalHint: Facts about you, interests and preferences are collected from your own messages and available across conversations. AI replies are excluded. Tone is controlled by the selected style and the separate writing style setting.
memory.chatHint: Facts about the contact, your relationship, agreements and events from available history. Deep analysis runs gradually and resumes after restart. The selected style controls the tone.
memory.notesHint: Markdown is supported. Summarization preserves these notes.
memory.empty: No summary yet. Start an update or wait for background processing.
memory.complete: History processed. Future updates use new messages.
memory.scanning: Deep history processing continues. Existing memory is already available for replies.
memory.collectionScopeHint: Both modes exclude channels and chats with memory turned off.

collectionScopes.all-allowed: All available private and group chats

storage.autoHint: Applies to new messages and chat browsing. Avatars, stickers and thumbnails load separately. Files up to 100 MB can be downloaded manually.
storage.cacheHint: Downloaded media only. Login, settings, models, memory and saved message text are preserved. Deleted media may become unavailable after clearing.

deleted.title: Deleted messages
deleted.hint: Messages received by the app before deletion are kept here. Media remain available while stored in the local cache.

internetSearch.title: Web search
internetSearch.hint: Free search is enabled by default. Links appear on request or according to chat settings.
internetSearch.keyless: Exa is disconnected. The primary search needs no key.
internetSearch.linksHint: Links are limited to relevant retrieved sources.

states.limited: Exa quota reached. The primary free search continues to work.
states.unavailable: Exa is unavailable. Fallback search is active.

internetSearch.free: No keys needed: DuckDuckGo with Bing fallback. Weather uses Open-Meteo.

modelDefaultHint: This conversation follows the model selected in Models. You can choose a separate model.

events.clearHint: Remove completed history. Pending tasks remain in the queue.
events.retention: History stays on this computer and remains available after a restart.

archive.title: History storage
archive.hint: History includes model requests and replies. It is stored locally for the current Telegram account.
archive.zero: 0 means unlimited. All history is kept by default.
archive.notRecording: New events are not being saved. Check free space and history settings.

events.timings: Model loading: {load} s · Prompt processing: {prompt} s
events.noThinking: The model did not provide a separate thinking trace.
events.waitingResponse: The response is still being generated.
events.noRequests: No model requests have been made.
events.pendingMetrics: Metrics arrive when the request completes.

feedback.title: Rate this reply
feedback.hint: What worked well, and what should change in future replies?
feedback.privacy: Ratings and comments stay on this computer. You can edit or remove them.
feedback.refreshFailed: Feedback saved. The events list could not refresh and will update later.

parallel.title: Parallel tasks
parallel.description: Replies, drafts and memory collection share one queue. Choose how many independent tasks may run at once.
parallel.gpuHint: More tasks do not automatically speed up a single local GPU. Local generation shares model access; parallel API calls also require independent task routing to be enabled.
parallel.estimateHint: This is a qualitative estimate. Usage depends on the model and computer. Readings below are current measurements, not a forecast.

events.memoryPrivacy: Conversation and memory contents are not recorded in this task history.

diagnostics.title: Errors
diagnostics.description: Application issues and steps to resolve them.
diagnostics.emptyDescription: If something goes wrong, details will appear here.
diagnostics.privacy: The log does not contain conversations, access keys or memory contents.

storageLocations.title: File locations
storageLocations.description: Application data, memory and local model folders on this computer.

computeDevice.title: AI compute device
computeDevice.label: Ollama device
computeDevice.nextStart: Applies at the next Ollama launch. The current reply will continue.
computeDevice.nvidiaOnly: Individual device selection supports NVIDIA. AMD and Intel remain available in automatic mode.
computeDevice.autoHint: Automatic mode preserves your system GPU settings.

limitations.external: This Ollama instance is managed by another process or service. Device selection is available for Ollama started by this app.
limitations.remote: Choose the compute device on the remote Ollama server.
limitations.missing-runtime: Install Ollama on the models page first.
limitations.next-start: The selection applies the next time the app starts Ollama.

reasons.compute: This GPU is not supported by this Ollama version.
reasons.driver: An NVIDIA driver update is recommended. Ollama will check compatibility.

modelPrompts.title: Model instructions
modelPrompts.hint: Added to the global prompt only when this model prepares a reply. The selected writing style retains priority.
modelPrompts.contextHint: Leave empty to size the context automatically. Larger windows use more memory.
modelPrompts.apiContextHint: The limit is configured in this model connection.

promptBudget.title: Model context
promptBudget.hint: An estimate without history or memory. Their messages will use the remaining space.
promptBudget.tooLong: Instructions and the reply reserve do not fit. Shorten the instructions or increase the working context.
promptBudget.automatic: The local context window adapts to the request size. Set an explicit limit in the model settings if needed.

settingsCenter.saveHint: Changes remain in the editor until you save.
settingsCenter.refreshWarning: Saved. The current view could not refresh; reopen it to update.

descriptions.application: Window behavior, tray and Windows startup.
descriptions.voice: Local voice message recognition, downloaded models and spoken replies.
descriptions.styles: Named styles with your own instructions.
descriptions.providers: Local Ollama models and compatible APIs in one place.
descriptions.routing: Use different models for replies, memory, research and images.
descriptions.compute: Choose the device for app-managed Ollama.
descriptions.search: Current information and optional search sources.
descriptions.memory: Facts, preferences and relationships. Writing style is controlled by the selected style and a separate matching option.
descriptions.collection: Update memory from new messages or collect conversation history.
descriptions.appearance: Create a palette and customize the interface.
descriptions.media: Choose which Telegram files download automatically.
descriptions.cache: Review local media usage and free up space.
descriptions.storage: Open application data, memory and models in Explorer.
descriptions.proactive: Conversation initiative and the pause before a new message.

appearance.colorsHint: Leave a color empty to use the base theme.
appearance.livePreviewHint: Colors update the example immediately. Preview applies the settings across the app.
appearance.exampleIncoming: Hey! How do you like the new theme?
appearance.cssHint: CSS rules apply only inside the application workspace. No imports, URLs or global at-rules.
appearance.cssScope: The settings center stays outside custom CSS so you can always reset your theme.
appearance.invalidTheme: Invalid theme or CSS is too long.
appearance.invalidColor: Use a hex color such as #4488ff.
appearance.unsafeCss: Imports, external resources and global CSS rules are not supported.

modelProfiles.empty: Add an Ollama endpoint or a compatible API to use your own model.
modelProfiles.name: Connection name
modelProfiles.keyHint: Leave blank to keep the saved key. The key is stored locally and is never returned to the interface.
modelProfiles.advancedHint: Blank sampling values use provider defaults. Unsupported options are omitted. A total timeout of 0 allows long reasoning; idle timeout still applies.
modelProfiles.capabilitiesHint: Match these options to the chosen model. API profiles can send conversations to an external provider.
modelProfiles.testHint: Runs a short request with the saved connection. Your provider may charge for this request.
modelProfiles.saveBeforeTest: Save the connection and all changes before testing.
modelProfiles.refreshFailed: Saved, but the current view could not refresh.
modelProfiles.emptyDescription: Add Ollama, OpenAI, or a compatible service. Choose separate connections for replies and memory.

modelRouting.priorityHint: An explicit model chosen for a chat takes priority over reply routing. Empty assignments use the primary model.
modelRouting.parallelHint: Parallel tasks may use more memory or API capacity. Tasks that depend on one another still run in sequence.
modelRouting.localHint: Choose an installed Ollama model or an API connection for each task. Enabling routing does not download models.

chatFeatures.photosHint: Requires an image-capable model. API models send photos to the selected provider.
chatFeatures.stickersHint: The assistant can choose stickers available in your Telegram account.

messageMenu.linkUnavailable: Telegram did not provide a link for this message.
messageMenu.refreshFailed: Changes were saved, but history could not refresh. Reopen the conversation.

draftQueue.cancelledDescription: You can prepare the reply again or write it yourself.
draftQueue.failedDescription: Try preparing the reply again or choose another model.

voice.recognitionHint: Transcribes incoming voice messages for AI. Off by default; audio is processed locally.

replyHints.text: Automatic replies use text. You can still generate a voice draft manually.
replyHints.always: Speaks every automatic reply using the selected voice.
replyHints.random: Chooses voice for each reply with the selected probability.
replyHints.mirror: Replies to voice messages with voice, and to other messages with text.

voice.previewHint: Speaks the entered text using the selected voice and current speed. Nothing is sent to Telegram.
voice.previewSample: Hello! This is a voice message test. The weather is nice today.
voice.assetsHint: Downloads start only when you choose. Each model needs the listed runtime; download both separately.
voice.downloadFailed: The model could not be downloaded. Try again.
voice.generationFailed: Could not prepare a voice draft.
voice.transcriptChanged: The text has changed. Update the voice before listening or sending.
voice.transcriptTooLong: Speech synthesis supports up to 4096 characters.
voice.playFailed: Audio could not be played. Update the voice and try again.
voice.modelsRequired: Download the selected voice and its runtime first.
voice.previewFailed: Could not synthesize speech. Check the installed models and try again.
voice.folderNotReady: The folder becomes available after installing or importing a model.
voice.importHint: Compatible sherpa-onnx VITS/Piper voices: a .tar.bz2 archive up to 100 MB with one folder containing model.onnx, tokens.txt and espeak-ng-data. Audio recordings and .pth files are not supported.
voice.importTooLarge: The archive must not be empty or larger than 100 MB.
voice.importFailed: Could not import the model. Check the archive contents and try again.
voice.importReady: Model imported. You can select it in the voice list.

hints.inherit: Uses the global message handling mode from assistant settings.
hints.replace: Cancels the current reply and starts a new one using the latest messages.
hints.finish: Finishes the current reply, then combines messages received during generation into one follow-up reply.
hints.each: Finishes the current reply, then answers each new message in order. The queue is bounded when traffic is high.

proactive.title: Keep the conversation going
proactive.hint: The global setting applies to chats with automatic replies. You can enable initiative independently in a chat’s settings — after sending a message, the assistant waits for a human reply.
proactive.messageTextHint: Sends this text after a pause. Automatic replies do not need to be enabled in this chat.
proactive.emptyChats: Initiative is not enabled in any available chat yet.
proactive.saveBeforeChat: Save the global changes before opening a chat’s settings.

messageDelete.title: Delete this message?
messageDelete.description: The message will be deleted from Telegram. A copy will remain in local history, marked as deleted and excluded from AI context.
messageDelete.unavailable: Telegram does not allow this message to be deleted.
messageDelete.refreshFailed: The message was deleted, but the chat could not be refreshed. Close this window and refresh the chat.

engineRestartExternal: Restart the external Ollama server manually.

messageEdit.unavailable: This message cannot be edited right now.
messageEdit.saveFailed: Could not confirm the change in Telegram.
messageEdit.changedElsewhere: The message has changed in Telegram. Your draft remains in the editor.
messageEdit.refreshFailedAfterSave: Changes saved. The editor could not be refreshed — reload the message before editing again.
messageEdit.discardDescription: Unsaved text and formatting will be lost.
messageEdit.tooLong: The text exceeds Telegram’s limit of {max} characters.
messageEdit.formattingUnavailable: The editor could not preserve formatting. Close it and open the message again.
messageEdit.invalidFormat: Telegram could not apply this formatting. Check the selected text and try again.
messageEdit.rateLimited: Telegram is limiting edits. Wait a little and try again.

messageEditFormat.error: The editor could not preserve formatting. Reopen the message.
